chunks: You have said, 'Our Lord is Allah.'
Then keep steadfast to His Book, to the way of His command, and to the virtuous course of His worship.
Thereafter do not go out of it, do not introduce innovations in it, and do not turn away from it.
Because those who go away from this course will be cut off from (the mercy of) Allah on the Day of Judgement.
ai.seo_question: What are the three things believers must remain steadfast in according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) links the declaration of faith, 'Our Lord is Allah,' to the practical necessity of steadfastness (istiqamah) in adhering to the Quran and the Sunnah without introducing innovations (bid'ah). This passage underscores the Shia emphasis on preserving the purity of worship by avoiding deviation, warning that such straying results in spiritual disconnection (inqita') from God on the Day of Judgment.
